title: RailFog Project Configuration
description: Deterministic configuration schema for RailFog minimal application infrastructure platform (railfog.toml and railfog.json). Governed by docs/contracts/platform.contract.md and docs/contracts/functions.contract.md.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema for editor autocomplete and validation.

name.description: Unique project identifier. Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only [a-zA-Z0-9_.-] (PLAT-18).

version.description: Semantic version string for the project.

runtime.description: Target runtime engine. RailFog runs on standard Deno LTS with V8 Isolates.

functions.description: Dictionary of declared serverless functions in the project.

entry.description: Relative file path to the function entrypoint module exporting a default handler (FN-1).

permissions.description: Strictly scoped capabilities injected at deployment time (PLAT-6). Functions have zero ambient access beyond declared permissions.

kv.description: List of scoped KV namespace identifiers accessible to this function (KV-2).

objects.description: List of object storage buckets accessible to this function (OBJ-2).

queues.description: List of message queues this function can publish messages to (Q-2).

network.description: Egress hostname allowlist. Edge SSRF firewall automatically blocks RFC1918, link-local, and cloud metadata IPs (PLAT-5).

secrets.description: List of encrypted environment secrets injected via ctx.env (PLAT-15).

triggers.description: Event triggers driving asynchronous function invocations (FN-2).

queue.description: Queue identifier that triggers this consumer function on message arrival (FN-2, Q-1).

schedule.description: Cron expression defining scheduled periodic execution (e.g. '0 * * * *').

limits.description: Per-invocation resource ceilings enforced by the isolation runner (FN-5).

memoryMb.description: Isolate memory ceiling in megabytes (maximum 128 MB per FN-5).

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock invocation deadline in seconds (maximum 30s per FN-5).

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent isolate executions permitted for this function.

routes.description: Deterministic HTTP route table resolved via PLAT-11 mathematical specificity scoring.

pattern.description: URLPattern path and optional method prefix (e.g. '/api/*', 'GET /items/:id') (PLAT-11).

function.description: Name of the target function declared in the functions block.

kv.description: Optional top-level configuration for project-wide KV namespaces (KV-2).

objects.description: Optional top-level configuration for project-wide Object storage buckets (OBJ-2).

queues.description: Optional top-level configuration for project-wide Queues (Q-2).
